start_containers: start multiple cloud containers for running MPC games with custom command arguments and environment variables
start_container: start a single cloud container for running an MPC game with optional TLS certificate and timeout
stop_containers: stop and cancel multiple running cloud container instances by their container IDs
wait_for_pending_containers: wait asynchronously for multiple pending cloud containers to reach a started state and return results
get_containers: get the current status and details of multiple cloud container instances by their instance IDs
